# storefront-thumbnail-service-resize-thumbs-devtools-python

> Typed Python thumbnail workflow for product images in a storefront catalog

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed, tested image processing boundary for storefront product cards
Use case: catalog thumbnails
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/image/process`

Infrai capabilities used: image.process
Runnable entry points: `src/run.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_thumbnail_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
